messages:
maria_tech: Quick FYI — post-deploy synthetic sweep for v2.14.0 is showing a cluster of transient 5xxs and a p95 latency regression on short text-gen prompts (<=12 tokens) in us-west2.

deploybot: Deploy finished: v2.14.0 -> us-west2 (canary=10%). Post-deploy synths kicked off.

sanjay: seeing it too. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~980ms for short_prompts. Errors look like 502/503 from inference-proxy.

alex_w: can someone paste a failing synth trace or example request? need repro data.

sanjay: synth trace snippet: ```
SYNTH-ID: syn-0x9f
route: text-gen-short
prompt: "hello"
error: inference-proxy: upstream EOF while decoding
latency_ms: 987
host: gw-usw2-12
```

jen-c: ran quick replay against v2.13.3 on the same hostset using our short_prompts corpus. Summary: v2.13.3 p95=128ms error_rate=0.1%; v2.14.0 p95=972ms error_rate=2.4%.

qa-bot: Synthetic runner: 12 failing samples / 512 checks, all in short_prompts bucket. Tokenizer diffs flagged in 9/12 failing cases.

maria_tech: sounds like a short-token code path regression (tokenizer or kv-cache interplay). ops-oncall, what's customer impact now?

ops-oncall: customer-visible error_rate for gen routes in us-west2 up from 0.03% to ~0.6% over last 10m. No SLA breach yet but trending up. Recommend immediate routing pin to previous stable variant for us-west2 while triage proceeds.

alex_w: +1 for pin. Also propose a config-canary toggling a conservative tokenizer fallback (config: token_flex=true) to see if that mitigates quickly.

maria_tech: proposed action: 1) pin us-west2 -> v2.13.3 immediately; 2) run config-canary: v2.14.0 with token_flex=true at 5-10% for 15m; 3) if canary stable, unpin and continue rollout with fix; else rollback and create hotfix. Any objections?

sanjay: no objections, will start digging into tokenizer diffs and try local reproducer on quantized kernels.

jen-c: initiating canary: `deploybot: apply-config-canary token_flex=true target=us-west2 percent=10 duration=15m`. Initial samples look closer to baseline p95 ~150ms.

deploybot: routing pin applied: us-west2 -> v2.13.3 (pinned by maria_tech). Config-canary started: v2.14.0 (token_flex=true) at 10%.

ops-oncall: notified support, created incident stub, and opened #incidents-to-eng for cross-team visibility. Monitoring dashboards updated and alert thresholds adjusted.

maria_tech: tracking — will reconvene in ~20m or earlier if canary regresses. tagging @sanjay @jen-c. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: acknowledged; updating runbook with timestamps and decision points.

maria_tech: closing this thread to reduce noise; post canary findings here only. If canary is stable after 15m we will unpin and proceed; if not, rollback.
